description: This source file defines the SugarConfig class, which manages configuration settings for SuiteCRM, including methods for retrieving and clearing cached configuration values.

classes.name: SugarConfig
classes.description: A class for managing configuration settings, implementing singleton pattern, caching config values, and providing get and clearCache methods.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the SugarConfig class.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value by key, optionally returning a default if not set, with caching.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears the cached configuration values, either entirely or for a specific key.
